`hydroscoper` is an R interface to the Greek National Data Bank for
Hydrological and Meteorological Information, *Hydroscope*. For more
details checkout the package’s
[website](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/) and the vignettes:

- [An introduction to
  `hydroscoper`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/articles/intro_hydroscoper.html)
  with details about the Hydroscope project and the package.
- [Using `hydroscoper`’s data
  sets](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/articles/stations_with_data.html)
  with a simple example of how to use the package’s internal data sets.

## Installation

Install the stable release from CRAN with:

``` r

install.packages("hydroscoper")
```

You can install the development version from GitHub with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ropensci/hydroscoper")
```

## Using hydroscoper

The functions that are provided by `hydroscoper` are:

- `get_stations, get_timeseries, ..., etc.` family functions, to
  retrieve tibbles with Hydroscope’s data for a given data source.
- `get_data`, to retrieve a tibble with time series’ values.  
- `hydro_coords`, to convert Hydroscope’s points’ raw format to a
  tibble.
- `hydro_translate` to translate various terms and names from Greek to
  English.

The data sets that are provided by `hydroscoper` are:

- `stations` a tibble with stations’ data from Hydroscope.
- `timeseries` a tibble with time series’ data from Hydroscope.
- `greece_borders` a tibble with the borders of Greece.

## Example

This is a minimal example which shows how to get the station’s *200200*
precipitation time series *56* from the *kyy* sub-domain.

Load libraries and get data:

``` r

library(hydroscoper)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

ts_raw <- get_data(subdomain = "kyy", time_id = 56)
ts_raw
```

Let’s create a plot:

``` r

ggplot(data = ts_raw, aes(x = date, y = value))+
  geom_line()+
  labs(title= "30 min precipitation for station 200200",
       x="Date", y = "Rain height (mm)")+
  theme_classic()
```

- Bug reports, suggestions, and code are welcome. Please see
  [Contributing](https://github.com/ropensci/hydroscoper/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

  - All code is licensed MIT.
  - All data are from the public data sources in
    `http://www.hydroscope.gr/`.

``` R
Vantas Konstantinos, (2018). hydroscoper: R interface to the Greek National Data Bank for
Hydrological and Meteorological Information. Journal of Open Source Software,
3(23), 625 DOI:10.21105/joss.00625
```

# Package index

## Hydroscoper

About the package

- [`hydroscoper`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/hydroscoper.md)
  [`hydroscoper-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/hydroscoper.md)
  : hydroscoper: Interface to Hydroscope

## Find Data

Functions that can be used to find data

- [`find_stations()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/find_stations.md)
  : Find nearest stations using a point's coordinates

## Download tables

Funtions that retrieve tibbles with Hydroscope’s data for a given data
source

- [`get_stations()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_timeseries()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_instruments()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_water_basins()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_water_divisions()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_political_divisions()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_variables()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_units_of_measurement()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_time_steps()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_owners()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_instruments_type()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_station_type()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  [`get_database()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_tables.md)
  : Get tibbles from Hydroscope

## Download time series

Retrieve a tibble with time series’ values from Hydroscope

- [`get_data()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/get_data.md)
  : Get time series values in a tibble

## Miscellaneous functions

Internal functions and helpers

- [`hydro_coords()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/hydro_coords.md)
  : Convert coordinates from Hydroscope's points to a tibble
- [`hydro_translate()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/hydro_translate.md)
  : Translate Greek names and terms to English

## Datasets

The internal datasets of the package

- [`greece_borders`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/greece_borders.md)
  : Greek borders
- [`stations`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/stations.md)
  : stations
- [`timeseries`](https://docs.ropensci.org/hydroscoper/reference/timeseries.md)
  : timeseries
